svg.title: IPv4 header
svg.desc: The IPv4 header from RFC 791, 32 bits per row. Row 1: Version (4 bits), IHL (4 bits), Type of Service (8 bits), Total Length (16 bits). Row 2: Identification (16 bits), Flags (3 bits), Fragment Offset (13 bits). Row 3: Time to Live (8 bits), Protocol (8 bits), Header Checksum (16 bits). Row 4: Source Address (32 bits). Row 5: Destination Address (32 bits). Row 6: Options (24 bits), Padding (8 bits).

g.text: RFC 791, Figure 4: Example Internet Datagram Header
